context.title: The Transparency Foundation: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: California — Proposition 39 (Prohibits Citizens from Voting Unless They Present Government-Issued Identification)

positions.statement: Johnathan Hale (Executive Director) signed the rebuttal to the argument against Proposition 39 in the official voter guide.

subject.title: San Diego County — Measure A (A Transparent, Accountable, Modern County Government)

positions.statement: Johnathan Hale (Executive Director, The Transparency Foundation) signed the rebuttal to the argument in favor of San Diego County Measure A and the argument against San Diego County Measure A in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
